headline: Bike used for firing at Tiger Shroff recovered by police, two detained
caption:
Tiger Shroff firing case update: bike mil gayi, 2 detained 🚨

Vile Parle mein Tiger Shroff par 5 round fire hue the. Police ne 15 teams banayi hain.
Sources ke mutabik, firing mein use hui bike Andheri Railway Station ke paas se baramad hui aur do log hirasat mein hain.
Bishnoi gang ke do alleged operatives ne hamle ki zimmedari li hai.
